description: HydroPip planning dimensions. These are working envelopes for layout decisions, not construction-survey measurements.
notes: The standard four-tower planning envelope is approximately 12 by 8 feet when the IBC is placed behind or beside the tower line.
The working envelope includes mature foliage and service access; exact placement changes with the IBC position, crop canopy, hose route, and obstacles.
Keep a usable route to the IBC opening, both pumps, hose-end flush valve, and the back and sides of the towers.
Mark the layout on the ground before driving supports and call 811 before digging or driving pipe.
